content.text:
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "$POSTGRES_USER" IN SCHEMA public
            GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO "$QGIS_DB_USER";
        
        -- Revoke access on model and route permissions
        REVOKE ALL ON model_permission FROM "$QGIS_DB_USER";
        REVOKE ALL ON route_permission FROM "$QGIS_DB_USER";
EOSQL
    echo "QGIS user created successfully"
else
    echo "QGIS_DB_USER or QGIS_DB_PASSWORD not set, skipping QGIS user creation"
fi

observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
p='postgres/init.sh'
s=open(p).read()
old="""        -- Revoke access on model and route permissions
        REVOKE ALL ON model_permission FROM "$QGIS_DB_USER";
        REVOKE ALL ON route_permission FROM "$QGIS_DB_USER";"""
new="""        -- Revoke access on model and route permissions (tables are created
        -- later by Django migrations, so tolerate their absence on first init)
        DO \\$\\$
        BEGIN
            IF to_regclass('public.model_permission') IS NOT NULL THEN
                EXECUTE 'REVOKE ALL ON model_permission FROM ' || quote_ident('$QGIS_DB_USER');
            END IF;
            IF to_regclass('public.route_permission') IS NOT NULL THEN
                EXECUTE 'REVOKE ALL ON route_permission FROM ' || quote_ident('$QGIS_DB_USER');
            END IF;
        END
        \\$\\$;"""
assert old in s, "old block not found"
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("patched init.sh")
PY
sed -n '60,80p' postgres/init.sh
